continuation_scope.recovery_interpretation: Restore positions, momenta, cell, PBC, masses, atom order, unwrapped positions, and all PCG64 streams exactly from the immutable step-2000 checkpoint. Reconstruct only the in-memory control-stage marker as A_HOT_1600K from the checksum-bound QA monitor and thermal log; this does not change the checkpoint or mark PENDING as PASS.

qa_status_policy.PENDING: remain in the current locked stage and continue only after every existing chunk archive, fresh-fetch, SHA, and restore gate passes
qa_status_policy.QA_HOLD: stop; do not begin another chunk
qa_status_policy.PASS: advance only under the existing locked stage-transition rules

automatic_stage_plan: Continue 1600 K hot-stage sampling until the locked joint criteria pass in two consecutive valid 2 ps windows after the locked transient discard.
Then linearly cool from 1600 K to 1250 K over the locked 5 ps ramp.
At 1250 K, equilibrate for at most 10 ps and transition only after the locked joint criteria pass.
Then perform the locked 5 ps candidate window, final QA, archive, and stop.

forbidden: start below global step 2000 or rerun steps 1000 through 2000
exceed 1000 steps or 3600 seconds in any chunk
reinitialize positions, velocities, or any RNG stream
modify the Ag EAM, density, cell, timestep, friction, temperature schedule, scientific locks, or QA criteria
start another trajectory, DFT, AIMD, TTM, or MACE training
change any prior data role or Ag64 step8000 ARCHIVED_HOLD status
